THE STAND The showrunners' commitment to the original source material is evident throughout The Stand; and by devoting a full nine hours to the apocalyptic tale, the series captures the novel's epic scope in a way that would not have been possible even in two featurelength films. "This story's characters are so rich," concluded Jake Braver, "and its arc is so sweeping, it was great to see it finally get its due. When we started making the show, we obviously had no idea we'd be finishing it remotely, in the midst of a pandemic - but what better moment to put out a show where the age-old struggle of good versus evil plays out during the rebuilding of civilization?
